messages.subject: For Antoine de Saint-Affrique | Sustainability, government relations and emerging-market strategy
messages.body:
Dear Danone Investor Relations Team,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Antoine de Saint-Affrique, Chief Executive Officer.

Danone's global health and nutrition platform operates across governments, regulators, communities and increasingly complex sustainability expectations. That interface closely matches my current mandate.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My responsibilities span government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory, with extensive cross-functional coordination in a regulated emerging-market environment.

I would welcome a senior discussion about where this experience might support Danone's sustainability, government-relations or international stakeholder priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to Danone.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
